source.purpose: tclean on a plane whose PSF peaks off-centre (issue 1124). Channel 0 of refim_point_linRL.ms holds few samples: its PSF peaks at pixel (13,64). The format is tools/casa-compat/tclean_case_matrix.py's.

off_centre_dirty.note: The beams of a dirty cube

off_centre_clean.note: The cycle sequence, from the sidelobe level

off_centre_clean_no_tie.note: The cycle sequence with no near-tie of the peak and the cycle threshold: at gain 0.2, one iteration leaves exactly the peak fraction 0.8 the cycle threshold clamps to
